comment: The Haro v0.23 conformance floor, written BEFORE the court that passes it (the W discipline: fixtures first, prose second). v0.23 grows v0.22 by the CONSTITUTION declaration -- the ruling of 2026-11-01 on Zin (COMPASS-KERN-09; charter section 2, ratified the same night): Zin's six articles enter Haro as a declared governance sentence that a world declares itself under, judged THROUGH the mechanisms the charter names and never reimplemented. ARTICLES names the articles the world is under, each a word of the six and each at most once; a language under explainability (1) declares a NARRATE and gives every REFUSAL and CONSTRAINT a CODE; under reversibility (2) it declares a REFINE; under predictable_authority (4) no policy point is floored llm; under trust_hierarchy (6) every point has a FLOOR. visible_state (3) and organizational_sovereignty (5) are refused by name as what Haro v0.23 does not judge yet (ZC3); WEAVES and REGIME are seats the grammar carries and v0.23 refuses by name (ZC4), so the sentence's whole shape is declared now. Every v0.22 declaration still passes: v0.23 refuses nothing v0.22 accepted (A3 is v0.13's A1, unchanged). Rejects carry the fragment the refusal must contain. The articles' numbers are Zin's (constitution.zig:35-40) and are stable.

accepts.name: a language under the four articles Haro v0.23 judges: a NARRATE, coded refusals and constraints, a REFINE with a floor on every point and no policy point floored llm
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text, ceiling: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION limit AS (VERB "LIMIT", SEATS [on: account, daily: number, rule: text, message: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT one_limit_per_account AS (ON limit, WHEN "earlier limit where on = this.on", MESSAGE "LIMIT {name} and {other} both stand on {on}: one limit an account", CODE "ONE_LIMIT") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "The verb set is closed", CODE "UNKNOWN_VERB") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE bank AS (POINTS [account.ceiling: knob, limit.daily: knob, limit.rule: policy, limit.message: field], FLOOR [account.ceiling: external, limit.daily: trusted, limit.rule: trusted, limit.message: llm]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [account: "{name} is held by {holder} up to {ceiling}."], REFUSES "Stopped at line {line}: {message} ({cites})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability, reversibility, predictable_authority, trust_hierarchy]) RATIONALE "the four articles Haro v0.23 judges, in Zin's order"

accepts.name: a language under one article only, reversibility: a REFINE is all it owes; no NARRATE, no CODE, no FLOOR is asked of it
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text, ceiling: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "The verb set is closed") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE bank AS (POINTS [account.ceiling: knob]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [reversibility]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: a v0.22 declaration is a v0.23 declaration: v0.13's A1, unchanged -- no CONSTITUTION, nothing asked
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE shop AS (VERSION "0.13", GRAMMAR "0.13", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".shop") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION item AS (VERB "ITEM", SEATS [price: number, label: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION till AS (VERB "TILL", SEATS [holds: name]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (OPENS "{file}: {count} things in {language}.", SAYS [item: "{name} costs {price} and is called {label}. {rationale}", till: "{verb} {name} holds {holds}, line {line}."], ENDS "That is all.", REFUSES "Stopped at line {line} with {code}: {message} ({cites})") RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: under predictable_authority alone a point may lack a FLOOR (that is trust_hierarchy's rule); what it asks is that no policy point be floored llm, and external is not llm
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text, ceiling: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION limit AS (VERB "LIMIT", SEATS [on: account, rule: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE bank AS (POINTS [account.ceiling: knob, limit.rule: policy], FLOOR [limit.rule: external]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [predictable_authority]) RATIONALE "x"

accepts.name: the CONSTITUTION may stand anywhere after the LANGUAGE: its articles are judged once the whole file is read, so a NARRATE and a REFINE declared after it count
accepts.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [trust_hierarchy, explainability, reversibility]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text, ceiling: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "The verb set is closed", CODE "UNKNOWN_VERB") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [account: "{name} is held by {holder}."], REFUSES "Stopped at line {line}: {message} ({cites})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE bank AS (POINTS [account.ceiling: knob], FLOOR [account.ceiling: external]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.name: an article is one of the six, by Zin's name and number; 'privacy' is a weave, not an article
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability, privacy]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: 'privacy' is not an article: explainability (1), reversibility (2), visible_state (3), predictable_authority (4), organizational_sovereignty (5) or trust_hierarchy (6)

rejects.name: an article is named once
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE bank AS (POINTS [account.holder: field]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [reversibility, reversibility]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: 'reversibility' is named twice in ARTICLES: a world is under an article once

rejects.name: a world is under one constitution
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE bank AS (POINTS [account.holder: field]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [reversibility]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION bylaws AS (ARTICLES [reversibility]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: a .haro file declares at most one CONSTITUTION

rejects.name: a constitution is under at least one article
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES []) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: ARTICLES names no article: a constitution is under at least one

rejects.name: Art. 1 explainability: a world under it tells its runs and refusals, so its language declares a NARRATE
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "The verb set is closed", CODE "UNKNOWN_VERB") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: Art. 1 explainability: 'bank' declares no NARRATE -- a world under explainability tells every run and every refusal in its own voice

rejects.name: Art. 1 explainability: a refusal is traceable by a stable identifier, so every REFUSAL carries a CODE
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFUSAL unknown_verb AS (MESSAGE "The verb set is closed") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [account: "{name} is held by {holder}."], REFUSES "Stopped at line {line}: {message} ({cites})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: Art. 1 explainability: REFUSAL 'unknown_verb' carries no CODE -- a refusal under explainability is traceable by its stable identifier (C2 2.1)

rejects.name: Art. 1 explainability: the same for a CONSTRAINT, the maker's own rule
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION limit AS (VERB "LIMIT", SEATS [on: account]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTRAINT one_limit_per_account AS (ON limit, WHEN "earlier limit where on = this.on", MESSAGE "LIMIT {name} and {other} both stand on {on}") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE NARRATE voice AS (SAYS [account: "{name} is held by {holder}."], REFUSES "Stopped at line {line}: {message} ({cites})") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [explainability]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: Art. 1 explainability: CONSTRAINT 'one_limit_per_account' carries no CODE -- a refusal under explainability is traceable by its stable identifier (C2 2.1)

rejects.name: Art. 2 reversibility: a world under it changes only by refinement, so its language declares a REFINE
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [reversibility]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: Art. 2 reversibility: 'bank' declares no REFINE -- a world under reversibility changes only by refinement, whose inverse is computed before it lands and whose revert is an event (charter 6.5)

rejects.name: Art. 6 trust_hierarchy: a trust requirement is declared, never implied, so every point has a FLOOR
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text, ceiling: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION limit AS (VERB "LIMIT", SEATS [on: account, daily: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE bank AS (POINTS [account.ceiling: knob, limit.daily: knob], FLOOR [account.ceiling: external]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [trust_hierarchy]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: Art. 6 trust_hierarchy: point 'limit.daily' has no FLOOR -- a trust requirement is declared, never implied: silence refuses

rejects.name: Art. 4 predictable_authority: a rule is refined by no model-composed proposal, so no policy point is floored llm
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text, ceiling: number]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION limit AS (VERB "LIMIT", SEATS [on: account, rule: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE bank AS (POINTS [account.ceiling: knob, limit.rule: policy], FLOOR [account.ceiling: external, limit.rule: llm]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [predictable_authority]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: Art. 4 predictable_authority: policy point 'limit.rule' has FLOOR llm -- a rule is refined by no model-composed proposal, by construction (charter 6.4)

rejects.name: Art. 3 visible_state is refused by name as what Haro v0.23 does not judge yet: a state, not a fault (ZC3)
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [visible_state]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: Art. 3 visible_state: no mechanism judges it in Haro v0.23 -- ZC3 builds it on the narration and the audit chain, fixtures first

rejects.name: Art. 5 organizational_sovereignty is refused by name as what Haro v0.23 does not judge yet (ZC3, on the zones Z declares)
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.refusal: Art. 5 organizational_sovereignty: no mechanism judges it in Haro v0.23 -- ZC3 builds it on the zones Z declares and W3's no ungoverned data movement, fixtures first

rejects.name: WEAVES is a seat the sentence carries and v0.23 judges by nothing: a weave named is refused as ZC4's, by name
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"

DEFINE REFINE bank AS (POINTS [account.holder: field]) RATIONALE "x"

rejects.refusal: WEAVES names 'privacy', and no weave is judged in Haro v0.23 -- ZC4 builds sovereignty (W3) and privacy (W4) as field tags, fixtures first

rejects.name: a weave is one of Zin's eight, by name and number
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE DECLARATION account AS (VERB "ACCOUNT", SEATS [holder: text]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE REFINE bank AS (POINTS [account.holder: field]) RATIONALE "x"
DEFINE CONSTITUTION charter AS (ARTICLES [reversibility], WEAVES [budget: advisory]) RATIONALE "x"
rejects.refusal: 'budget' is not a weave: resilience (W1), observability (W2), sovereignty (W3), privacy (W4), temporal_integrity (W5), cost_awareness (W6), learnability (W7) or structural_integrity (W8)

rejects.name: a weave's severity is one of Zin's three
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.refusal: 'loud' is not a severity: constitutional, governance or advisory

rejects.name: REGIME is a seat the sentence carries and v0.23 reads by nothing: a regime named is refused as ZC4's, by name -- never a default
rejects.source:
DEFINE LANGUAGE bank AS (VERSION "0.23", GRAMMAR "0.23", COURT "x", EXTENSION ".bank") RATIONALE "x"

rejects.refusal: REGIME names 'gdpr', and no weave reads a regime in Haro v0.23 -- ZC4 names the declared regime in every refusal of a weave, never a default

rejects.name: the first article refused is the first in ARTICLES' order, so a refusal names one article at a time
rejects.source:
